passages.ko: 이는 곧 단에 기름 바르던 날에 이스라엘 족장들이 드린바 단의 봉헌 예물이라 은반이 열 둘이요 은바리가 열 둘이요 금숟가락이 열 둘이니

passages.en: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

passages.en: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
